Deprecated: fit curves with the old interface

Source: R/fit_curves.R
fit_curves-deprecated.Rd

fit_curves() and logisticFit() were a second copy of the gDR Hill fit, with hard-coded priors. They are now thin wrappers over fit_drug_response_metrics, the single gDR Hill fit, whose priors and bounds come from inst/extdata/fit_profiles.json and whose optimiser is a parameter (solver_drc by default). They are deprecated and will be defunct in the next release: call fit_drug_response_metrics(avg_dt, x_0 = ) once per normalization type instead.

Usage

fit_curves(
  df_,
  series_identifiers,
  e_0 = 1,
  GR_0 = 1,
  n_point_cutoff = 4,
  range_conc = c(0.005, 5),
  force_fit = FALSE,
  pcutoff = 0.05,
  cap = 0.1,
  normalization_type = c("GR", "RV")
)

logisticFit(
  concs,
  norm_values,
  std_norm_values = NA,
  x_0 = 1,
  priors = NULL,
  lower = NULL,
  range_conc = c(0.005, 5),
  force_fit = FALSE,
  pcutoff = 0.05,
  cap = 0.1,
  n_point_cutoff = 4,
  capping_fold = 5
)

Arguments

df_

data.table or DFrame with the concentrations in series_identifiers, the responses in x, optionally their standard deviation in x_std, and normalization_type.

series_identifiers

string, the concentration column of df_.

e_0, GR_0

upper asymptote of the RV and of the GR fit.

n_point_cutoff, range_conc, force_fit, pcutoff, cap, capping_fold

passed to fit_drug_response_metrics().

normalization_type

normalization types to fit, among "GR" and "RV".

concs

concentrations, not logged.

norm_values

responses, the same length as concs.

std_norm_values

their standard deviation.

x_0

upper asymptote, or NA to fit it.

priors, lower

ignored: the start values and bounds are those of the normalization type's fit profile. A lower value below zero for x_inf still selects the GR profile, as the GR priors did.

Value

fit_curves(): a data.table with one row per normalization type, fit_source "gDR", and rownames "<type>_gDR". logisticFit(): a one-row data.table of metrics and fit parameters.

Examples

suppressWarnings(logisticFit(
  c(0.001, 0.00316227766016838, 0.01, 0.0316227766016838),
  c(0.9999964000144, 0.999964001439942, 0.999640143942423, 0.996414342629482),
  rep(0.1, 4)
))
#>    normalization_type    x_mean        x_AOC x_AOC_range     x_max x_sd_avg
#>                <char>     <num>        <num>       <num>     <num>    <num>
#> 1:                 RV 0.9994663 0.0005336782  0.07214082 0.9964143      0.1
#>    N_conc maxlog10Concentration      ec50  xc50        h    r2          rss
#>     <int>                 <num>     <num> <num>    <num> <num>        <num>
#> 1:      4                  -1.5 0.2030077   Inf 2.014503     1 3.425795e-13
#>         p_value   x_0     x_inf               fit_type
#>           <num> <num>     <num>                 <char>
#> 1: 3.799066e-08     1 0.8446057 DRC3pHillFitModelFixS0
